name: MNN-Pocket-0.3B
context_scaling: config.json max_position_embeddings 40960 with rope_theta 1e6 and no rope_scaling block. The card markets it as 'up to 32K tokens'; the OVERSHOOT is the config default, not a tested length - no long-context eval is printed anywhere on the card. Treat 32K as the documented figure.
attention_variant: qwen3 decoder, 14 query heads / 2 KV heads (GQA 7:1), head_dim 64, full attention in all 28 layers (config layer_types is 28x full_attention, sliding_window null, use_sliding_window false).
notes: ADDED 2026-11-10 from the trending crawl (trendingScore page 2, 1,133 downloads / 90 likes at crawl; repo created 2026-09-23). WHAT IT IS: a ~300M on-device instruction-tuned model from Alibaba's MNN team, co-designed with the MNN inference stack, released with a real tech report (arXiv 2611.12311) and an INT4 W4A16 QAT sibling (173 MB) that the card says loses only 0.41pp of the 11-benchmark average. PARAMS: safetensors.total 361,551,232 -> params_b 0.3616. The card and repo name say '0.3B'; the tensor total is 0.36B, and the name rounds down. Dense, so active = total. ARCHITECTURE: config.json is a stock qwen3 decoder - 28 layers, hidden 896, 14 query / 2 KV heads, head_dim 64, intermediate 2560, vocab 65536, tie_word_embeddings true, use_cache FALSE. Both the base and the post-trained repo report the same 361,551,232 tensors. DERIVED (arithmetic): kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 28 layers x 2 KV heads x 64 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes (bf16) = 14,336 bytes/token. All 28 layers are full_attention per config layer_types, sliding_window null, so there is no windowed subset to exclude. flops_per_token_active = 2 x 0.3616e9 = 7.231e8. HARDWARE GATE: passes easily - 0.36B BF16 is ~0.72 GB of weights and 14 KB/token of KV, so 32K context costs ~0.45 GB of cache. This is the runnable end of the catalog. WHAT IT EVIDENCES: eleven rows, of which seven are same-table wins against at least one larger model. The strongest are HumanEval +5.49pp over MiniCPM4-0.5B (a 39% larger model) and IFEval +16.27pp over Qwen3-0.6B. Four rows are recorded as LOSSES: C-Eval and CMMLU (badly, to MiniCPM4-0.5B), BBH, MATH500 and MBPP. CAVEATS: every number is a vendor claim and the per-benchmark protocol lives only in a tech report that is not on the Hub, so prompt format and shot count are unverified. The baselines are the card's own runs, not independently reproduced. The 'best average among ~300M models' claim survives this table but does not survive the Chinese exam rows, where a 0.5B model wins by 25-29pp.

benchmarks.name: 11-benchmark zh/en average
benchmarks.config: Card table 'Post-trained MNN-Pocket-0.3B vs. same-size and larger open models', row Average, column 'MNN-Pocket-0.3B'. The card does not print the per-benchmark protocol inline; it defers to 'Full protocol in the tech report' (arXiv 2611.12311), which is neither shipped in the repo nor reproduced on the card, so the harness and prompt format are unverified. Averaged over C-Eval, CMMLU, MMLU-Redux, BBH, IFEval, IFEval-zh, GSM8K, MGSM-zh, MATH500, HumanEval and MBPP. WINS vs MiniCPM4-0.5B 46.81, Qwen3-0.6B 44.28, ERNIE-4.5-0.3B 31.99, LFM2.5-350M 31.28, Hunyuan-0.5B 31.22, SmolLM2-360M 18.43 and Gemma-3-270M 6.42 - so it beats three models with 40-70% more parameters on this average. LOSS of 0.41pp vs its own INT4 W4A16 build (49.59), printed by the card.

benchmarks.name: IFEval
benchmarks.config: Same table, row IFEval. WINS vs LFM2.5-350M 72.09, Qwen3-0.6B 56.93, MiniCPM4-0.5B 52.13, ERNIE-4.5-0.3B 44.92, SmolLM2-360M 32.16, Hunyuan-0.5B 24.58 and Gemma-3-270M 20.15; widest margin in the row is +16.27pp over Qwen3-0.6B. Context only, not a same-table row: the catalog's lfm2-5-1-2b prints 86.23 on IFEval, but it is 1.17B and a different card.

benchmarks.name: HumanEval
benchmarks.config: Same table, row HumanEval. WINS vs every listed baseline: MiniCPM4-0.5B 48.17, ERNIE-4.5-0.3B 38.41, Qwen3-0.6B 36.59, LFM2.5-350M 14.63, Hunyuan-0.5B 14.63, SmolLM2-360M 0.00 and Gemma-3-270M 0.00. Largest same-table win in the record: +5.49pp over MiniCPM4-0.5B, a model 39% larger.

benchmarks.name: MGSM-zh
benchmarks.config: Same table, row MGSM-zh. WINS vs Qwen3-0.6B 40.00, MiniCPM4-0.5B 37.60, Hunyuan-0.5B 34.80, ERNIE-4.5-0.3B 25.20, LFM2.5-350M 18.00, SmolLM2-360M 3.60 and Gemma-3-270M 0.00. No prior MGSM-zh row exists anywhere in the catalog, so this is the first datapoint rather than a beaten-best claim.

benchmarks.name: IFEval-zh
benchmarks.config: Same table, row IFEval-zh. WINS vs Qwen3-0.6B 50.35, LFM2.5-350M 44.06, ERNIE-4.5-0.3B 32.87, Hunyuan-0.5B 25.87, SmolLM2-360M 25.64, Gemma-3-270M 17.02 and MiniCPM4-0.5B 30.30. Second-largest margin in the record at +24.24pp over Qwen3-0.6B, but the card gives no Chinese-instruction-tuning detail and the tech report is not on the Hub.

benchmarks.name: MATH500
benchmarks.config: Same table, row MATH500. LOSSES recorded: Qwen3-0.6B 45.20 (-9.80pp) and Hunyuan-0.5B 35.80 (-0.40pp) both beat it. Wins vs MiniCPM4-0.5B 23.00, ERNIE-4.5-0.3B 21.40, LFM2.5-350M 14.80 and the zeros from SmolLM2-360M / Gemma-3-270M. Cannot be compared to the catalog's qwen3-5-0-8b-weight-space-programming 48.1 on MATH-500: different benchmark name on the card (MATH500 vs MATH-500) and a different harness.

benchmarks.name: BBH
benchmarks.config: Same table, row BBH. LOSSES recorded: Hunyuan-0.5B 54.65 (-7.27pp) and MiniCPM4-0.5B 47.61 (-0.23pp) both beat it, so the 0.3B is NOT best-in-row here despite the average column. Wins vs Qwen3-0.6B 41.94, ERNIE-4.5-0.3B 31.07, SmolLM2-360M 27.74, LFM2.5-350M 26.03 and Gemma-3-270M 8.09.

benchmarks.name: C-Eval
benchmarks.config: Same table, row C-Eval. LOSSES recorded: MiniCPM4-0.5B 67.98 (-29.12pp) and Qwen3-0.6B 44.06 (-5.20pp). Wins vs ERNIE-4.5-0.3B 32.17, LFM2.5-350M 32.10, Hunyuan-0.5B 35.29, SmolLM2-360M 23.77 and Gemma-3-270M 6.84. Chinese knowledge is the weakest axis of a model the card markets as bilingual, and it is where the larger baselines open their widest gap.

benchmarks.name: MMLU-Redux
benchmarks.config: Same table, row MMLU-Redux. LOSSES recorded: MiniCPM4-0.5B 52.85 (-8.85pp) and Qwen3-0.6B 51.63 (-7.63pp). Wins vs LFM2.5-350M 41.01, Hunyuan-0.5B 36.29, ERNIE-4.5-0.3B 32.68, SmolLM2-360M 24.17 and Gemma-3-270M 13.58.

benchmarks.name: CMMLU
benchmarks.config: Same table, row CMMLU. LOSSES recorded: MiniCPM4-0.5B 66.04 (-25.93pp) and Qwen3-0.6B 44.50 (-4.39pp). Wins vs ERNIE-4.5-0.3B 33.91, LFM2.5-350M 31.65, Hunyuan-0.5B 35.69, SmolLM2-360M 24.87 and Gemma-3-270M 4.94. The MiniCPM4-0.5B gap on both Chinese exam rows is the single clearest argument against the card's 'best average among ~300M models' framing generalising to Chinese knowledge.

benchmarks.config: Same table, row GSM8K. WINS vs Qwen3-0.6B 45.49, MiniCPM4-0.5B 42.46, Hunyuan-0.5B 36.01, LFM2.5-350M 33.66, ERNIE-4.5-0.3B 31.24, SmolLM2-360M 11.60 and Gemma-3-270M 0.00. Best in row.
